title: Pullback of a compatible line scalar square through all signed powers
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be sites with finite limits and final objects, small relative to a common sheaf universe [def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let $u:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ preserve finite limits and coverings, and write $f^{-1}:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D)$ for its geometric inverse image. Let $R\xrightarrow{\iota}S$ on $\mathcal C$ and $R'\xrightarrow{\iota'}S'$ on $\mathcal D$ be commutative ring sheaves, with maps $a:f^{-1}R\to R'$, $b:f^{-1}S\to S'$ satisfying $b f^{-1}(\iota)=\iota'a$. These define morphisms of ringed topoi [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism]. Put $F_R(M)=f^{-1}M\otimes_{f^{-1}R}R'$ and $F_S(N)=f^{-1}N\otimes_{f^{-1}S}S'$, using module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and sheaf tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Let $P,Q$ be locally free rank-one module sheaves over $R,S$, and $P',Q'$ locally free rank-one over $R',S'$ (locally isomorphic to their ring sheaves on coverings of the final objects). Suppose given isomorphisms
$$c:P\otimes_R S\xrightarrow{\sim}Q,\quad c':P'\otimes_{R'}S'\xrightarrow{\sim}Q',\quad p:F_R(P)\xrightarrow{\sim}P',\quad q:F_S(Q)\xrightarrow{\sim}Q'$$
satisfying $q\circ F_S(c)=c'\circ(p\otimes1)$ under the canonical tensor reassociation $F_S(P\otimes_R S)\cong F_R(P)\otimes_{R'}S'$. Define signed powers $P^{[0]}=R$, $P^{[n]}=P^{\otimes n}$, $P^{[-n]}=\mathcal Hom_R(P^{[n]},R)$ for $n>0$, and similarly for the other three lines, with sheaf Hom [def-pur-sheaf-hom]. Let $c_m,c'_m$ be the signed scalar comparisons normalized by the unit, positive tensor recursion and the evaluation formula of [lem-pur-signed-line-scalar-tensor-tower]. There exist unique families of isomorphisms $p_m:F_R(P^{[m]})\xrightarrow{\sim}(P')^{[m]}$, $q_m:F_S(Q^{[m]})\xrightarrow{\sim}(Q')^{[m]}$ whose degree-one maps are $p,q$, degree-zero maps are the coefficient-unit maps, positive maps obey tensor recursion, and negative maps are the transpose of pulled-back evaluation followed by precomposition with the inverse positive map. In particular
$$\operatorname{ev}(p_{-n}(z),p_n(w))=F_R(\operatorname{ev})(z\otimes w)$$
under the canonical tensor and unit comparisons, and likewise for $q$. For every integer $m$ one has the equality
$$q_m\circ F_S(c_m)=c'_m\circ(p_m\otimes1)$$
under $F_S(P^{[m]}\otimes_R S)\cong F_R(P^{[m]})\otimes_{R'}S'$. No flatness or invertibility is assumed for $a,b,\iota,\iota'$.
